title: Boeing Finally Clears MAX 10, O'Leary Predicts Pain, and Everyone's Canceling Routes At Once
summary: The 737 MAX 10 just cleared its last hurdle after seven years of delays — but does anyone actually want it anymore? Plus, Ryanair's CEO says European airfares could jump 20% next year, American's about to make a massive bet on Asia, and two airlines quietly gut their route maps on the same day.
